description: Exact dual certificate of the three-point SDP bound with clique cuts. bound = h[e] + sum_{q free} rho[q] + nu^T t + sum_{q free, q != e} max(0, h[q]); h[q] = obj[q] + <Y1,G_q> + <Y2,Gy_q> + (mu^T Cy)_q - (nu^T A)_q - rho[q]. Cut rows A (rhs t) are the lifted clique inequalities (C1)/(C2) of bounds.sdp3_cliques; each instance (kind, a, b, K) is recorded so the row can be re-derived from the vectors and orbitals.json alone.
